subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Read each passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

He stayed up all night helping a stranger fix a flat tire in the rain.

He is:
A) lazy
B) kind/selfless
C) rude

steps: Helped a stranger. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The wind clawed at the shutters and the candle guttered low.

The mood is:
A) cheerful
B) tense/ominous
C) silly

To support an interpretation of a text, you should use:
A) evidence from the text
B) a guess
C) the cover price

steps: Use text evidence. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Though the award should have been hers, Priya smiled, congratulated the winner, and resolved to train harder.

Priya is:
A) bitter and lazy
B) gracious and determined
C) dishonest

steps: Her response shows character. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

'Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.'

This compares hope to a bird, so it is a:
A) metaphor
B) summary
C) fact

steps: Hope IS a bird. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The story jumps back to his childhood to explain his fear of water.

This structure is a:
A) flashback
B) cliffhanger
C) climax

steps: Time jump back. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The narrator insists he is always honest, yet the other characters catch him lying again and again.

The narrator is best described as:
A) reliable
B) unreliable
C) omniscient

steps: His claims contradict the evidence. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The king who trusted no one and spied on everyone ended his reign alone, surrounded only by enemies.

The BEST theme is:
A) Kings should spy more.
B) Distrust and cruelty breed isolation.
C) Castles are large.
items.answer: B) Distrust and cruelty breed isolation.

steps: His choices caused his isolation. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Distrust and cruelty breed isolation.
